name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's fascination with motorsport began in his youth, captivated by the engineering feats displayed during Formula 1 races. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics, before landing a junior role at a local racing team. His meticulous attention to detail and knack for problem-solving quickly propelled him up the ranks. 

Park joined Mitsubishi Motorsport five years ago, quickly becoming an invaluable asset due to his analytical abilities and adaptability. He excels at fine-tuning car setups based on driver feedback and telemetry data, always seeking that extra tenth of a second. Known for his calm demeanor under pressure and innovative solutions, he's respected by both drivers and mechanics alike. His strength is finding innovative solutions that deliver a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: A man of average height with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas, even during meals.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Prefers to work late into the night when the garage is quiet and undisturbed.
